title: marketing
text:
marketing

maria_k: morning async — quick standup
What I did: finalized content calendar for launch week (Mon-Fri). Uploaded 5 benchmark posts to staging blog.
Blockers: CDN thumbnails returning 404 on staging.
Today: need an eng check for a CDN canary + quick CR for the embed snippet. pinging @samuel_e @jamie

samuel_e: on it — can check CDN in ~30m. which path?

maria_k: /assets/launch/hero-*.png — staging logs show:
```
GET /assets/launch/hero-small.png 404
GET /assets/launch/hero-large.png 404
```

tasha: merged the copy edits earlier. pinging @jamie to review the JS embed PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/412

jamie: reviewing now. if it's small i'll merge and coordinate a canary for staging. fyi bench on latest posts: render ~120ms, TTFB ~2.3s on staging.

samuel_e: spotted a misconfigured rule in the CDN edge config, recreating the rule now.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started to staging at 1765432150

deploy-bot: Canary deployment: staging-cdn-rule v2 -> success (10% edge nodes) :white_check_mark:

maria_k: thanks — once canary is green i'll flip the calendar status to "ready" and notify ops. also shared social copy in #marketing-social for a quick look.

tasha: social copy looks clean, adjusted CTA slightly — done.

jamie: merged PR and left a tiny comment about escaping in the snippet. @samuel_e can you confirm there's no sensitive logging from the embed?

samuel_e: confirmed no token leakage in logs. canary healthy, rolling to 100% in 15m.

maria_k: awesome — today's wrap: content calendar final, 5 benchmark posts uploaded, CDN thumbnails issue resolved. blockers: none. :tada:
